factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated EBITDA for 06 months of 2026 decreased by 0.8% and was 7 508 thousand EUR, compared to 7 566 thousand EUR for 06 months of 2025.

factual_claims.claim: Reported net profit attributable to equity holders fell sharply by 31.5% to 3,961 thousand EUR, reducing earnings per share to 0.11 EUR from 0.16 EUR in the prior year.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Net profit attributable to equity holders of the Parent company for 06 months of 2026 amounted 3 961 thousand EUR. Net profit attributable to equity holders of the Parent company for 06 months of 2025 amounted 5 781 thousand EUR. Earnings per share (EUR) for 06 months of 2026 was 0.11 (0.16 for 06 months of 2025).

factual_claims.claim: Despite the decline in accounting profits, cash generation improved substantially.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Operating cash flow for the period increased from 3 481 thousand EUR (06m 2025) to 6 842 thousand EUR (06m 2026).

factual_claims.claim: Operating cash flow nearly doubled, climbing 96.6% to 6,842 thousand EUR, largely fueled by effective working capital management and a 1,535 thousand EUR drawdown in inventory levels.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Operating cash flow for the period [06m 2026] was 6 842 thousand EUR vs 3 481 thousand EUR [06m 2025] representing a 96.6% increase. Inventory balance decreased by 1 535 thousand EUR from 31 237 thousand EUR (31.12.2025) to 29 702 thousand EUR (30.06.2026).

factual_claims.claim: The financial position remained solid, with total assets growing to 98,603 thousand EUR and equity attributable to parent shareholders increasing by 6.1% to 81,479 thousand EUR.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Total assets as of 30 June 2026 amounted to 98 603 thousand EUR representing increase by 5.1% as compared to 31 December 2025. Equity attributable to equity holders of the Parent company increased by 6.1% to 81 479 thousand EUR as of 30 June 2026.

factual_claims.claim: Liquid resources strengthened considerably, with cash and short-term deposits totaling 51,150 thousand EUR.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Cash and cash equivalents as of 30 June 2026 was 12 443 thousand EUR. Short-term deposits over 3 months as of 30 June 2026 was 38 707 thousand EUR. Total = 12 443 + 38 707 = 51 150 thousand EUR.

factual_claims.claim: Liquidity ratios improved accordingly, with the current ratio rising to 10.3 and the quick ratio reaching 6.7.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Current ratio as of 30.06.2026 was 10.3. Quick ratio as of 30.06.2026 was 6.7.

factual_claims.claim: Regional performance diverged across the Group’s primary markets.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Sales performance varied significantly across Russia, Belarus, Ukraine, Baltics and Other markets as detailed in the Management Report and Geographical segments table.

factual_claims.claim: Sales in Russia decreased slightly by 0.6% in EUR terms, while local currency revenues fell by 7.8%, leading management to prioritize retail profitability and reduce owned store locations to 67.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: The Group’s sales on the Russian market totalled 15 767 thousand EUR, decrease is 0.6% compared to 06 months of 2025. Local currency sales decreased by 7.8% during 06 months of 2026. At the end of the reporting period, there were a total of 67 stores operated by the Group itself (as of 31 December 2025: 69 stores).

factual_claims.claim: Belarus delivered resilient growth, with sales up 6.4% in EUR terms alongside positive local currency movements.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: The Group’s sales in Belarus in the 06 months of 2026 were 9 046 thousand EUR and increased by 6.4% compared to the 06 months of 2025. Sales in local currency increased by 2.7% during the same period.

factual_claims.claim: Declines were recorded in the Baltics and other international territories.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Baltics sales were 484 thousand EUR in 06m 2026 vs 581 thousand EUR in 06m 2025 (-16.7%). Other markets sales were 3 278 thousand EUR in 06m 2026 vs 3 454 thousand EUR in 06m 2025 (-5.1%).

factual_claims.claim: To reinforce its balance sheet, the shareholder meeting resolved to retain the entire 2025 net profit within retained earnings rather than distribute dividends.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: The Annual General Meeting approved to leave the net profit undistributed and include the net profit of the financial year 2025 in the retained earnings.

factual_claims.claim: Overall, the reporting period reflected a strategic transition toward retail operations, disciplined cost control, and strengthened liquidity amidst fluctuating macroeconomic conditions in core markets.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: The Management Report details increased retail revenue (13.6% growth), reduced cost of goods sold (4.8% decrease), improved operating cash flow (96.6% increase) and enhanced liquidity ratios occurring during a period of mixed market conditions.
